expandedOwnerAndLegacyStage.limit: Native source9 and both existing service/audit suites19 passed. Four activity route mock expectations still omitted the new actual reader argument; their response and permission assertions were not weakened.

correctedReaderTransportAndNativeOwners.limit: Native source9 and existing activity route10 passed. Production bytes are unchanged in the final10-case source stage, which adds malformed/missing/foreign source controls only.

observations: Three actual PostgreSQL/current-Human HTTP controls first reproduced private Task metadata exposure in company activity, unified audit pagination/enrichment, and CSV export. A company audit grant did not imply source Task access. The private owner remains authorized while the other reader receives the next public row, without a private cursor or title/details leak.

The shared SQL narrowing uses the existing native Task/Project/run source graph. A new run SQL projection is the same expression as the original direct run reader, not a separate run authorization implementation. Native entity UUID casts are guarded; each owner and its company must actually exist.

Both activity and audit base row queries apply source privacy before LIMIT and audit cursor/enrichment. CSV uses the same filtered cursor pages. An actual run_id remains an independent source root even for company-type events. Native comments resolve through their actual Task; native document link/document IDs require same-company document and Task owners, rejecting any unreadable matching link.

HTTP routes supply the actual request actor after parsing customer filters. A query claiming the other actual user/session cannot supply this reader. Service-only unqualified callers use the privacy-none reader; the original company and audit permission gates remain independent.

The final10 native controls cover private/public Task activity, unified audit, CSV, comment, document-link ID, document ID, heartbeat-run entity, run reference on another entity, original native HTTP-created Project (subsequently made private by its domain owner), and malformed/missing/foreign native owners. Private fixture creation exercises domain/history state; product HTTP private-work admission is not enabled. Document/run fixtures provide actual native owner relationships, not complete payload/run receipt qualification.
limits: This is native source privacy narrowing, not complete action authorization for every source/agent scope or full private-work/read-family acceptance. Original company/audit grants remain independently required.

Other activity entity families remain on their previous path. Issue-specific activity/run projections, other downstream metadata references, physical source/auth row pins through enrichment/export, credential/revocation waits and response/stream lifetimes require further work.
The existing canonical graph still has six known typed/private-Memory/temporal regressions. Reusing it does not claim to fix those or qualify complete Native input receipts.

Domain tests use real native DB users, sessions and memberships with a structural HTTP carrier, not maintained cookie/cryptographic or provider/hardware qualification. UI product code did not change and the browser suite was not repeated for this read-only backend slice.
No full V10, PR-ready, SaaS/release, compliance, merge or deployment acceptance is claimed.
